text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Here we go... One, two. Da-daa-la~♪ 
Ta-ta-ta-ta~♪ Heavy at the start!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, maiden fair~ why must you wet~ your 
rosy cheeks~ with tears so bitter~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trials, tribulations, and pressure 
galore~♪ Like a demon lord! They struck 
down upon me~♪ And threw me to the floor~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I hear the cries of sorrow echoing across 
the world... Fear not, for I have arrived!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold♪ Behold me♪ Fluttering my 
rose-tinted cape, leading the world to 
hope, the Overlord~♪ Where no difficulty 
could ever exiiist~♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The Supreme Overlord blessed by the Three 
Goddesses~♪ Whose radiant light shall 
shine upon all and nurture them~♪ Praise! 
Advance! Together with Opera O~~♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Splendid! You are a ge-ni-us!! Making 
beautiful me the academy's symbol, and the 
star of a song that encourages Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Opera O-san's *eroicamente* charm! With 
this, the Umamusume will surely thrive 
each day and perform an even more 
beautiful ensemble!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Then let us head to the Chairwoman's 
office together. To propose the new Tracen 
Academy school anthem...!
